overview: Scale- & Distortion-Aware Moving Prototype Flow (SMPF) is a clock-free, constant-learning-rate ParticleGAN formulation inspired by s-means (Kocabay, Yuksel & Yalcin, 2026; https://suayptalha.github.io/s-means-blog/) and building on ParticleGAN's e-means-inspired EMPF, with no EMA critic network copy. SMPF replaces EMPF's 1D rank initialization and count-only prototype splitting with a checkpointed s-means sufficient-statistics bank (proto_centroids, proto_usage, proto_sse, feat_scale, fast_sum, fast_count) featuring 4-round deterministic D^1.5 coreset seeding, tiled addmm nearest-prototype assignment, distortion x usage^0.35 anisotropic RMS dead-prototype revival across all dimensions d >= 1, and Empirical-Bayes count-shrunk centroids (tau=0.20), and couples those denoised prototypes directly to generator training via thermally matched physical Born-Infeld Sinkhorn divergence, per-prototype RMS distortion shells, affine-detrended whitened conditional fiber transport, and connected-manifold simplicial chord alignment.
symbols: $G$ is the generator, $D$ the raw-score critic, $P$ the task prior with $M$ locations in $\mathbb R^{d_z}$, $x$ a real batch of size $B_r$, $z\sim P$ a latent batch and $y=G(z)$ the generated batch of size $B_f$. $(C, u, \text{sse}, v, S^{\text{fast}}, N^{\text{fast}})$ is the online s-means bank of size $K=\min(K_{\max}, B_r)$ with Empirical-Bayes centroids $C_k^{\mathrm{eb}}$, normalized masses $w_k=u_k/\sum_j u_j$, and local RMS quantization radii $\ell_k=\sqrt{\text{sse}_k/u_k}$. $\Pi_{pf}, \Pi_{ff}$ are detached Sinkhorn couplings for physical Born-Infeld costs $c_{\ell_k}(C_k^{\mathrm{eb}}, y_j)=\sqrt{\ell_k^2+\lVert y_j-C_k^{\mathrm{eb}}\rVert_2^2}-\ell_k$.
pseudocode: Choose an adversarial loss, DualNorm/Adam optimizer and constant learning rates.
Sample real x and latent z from the task prior P; compute y=G(z).

On unconditioned continuous vector and compact image domains, seed (4-round D^1.5) or assign x to C via tiled addmm, update (C, u, sse, feat_scale, S_fast, N_fast) with state-settling power-cosine alpha_eff, revive starved prototypes (u_k < 0.10 mean(u)) by splitting top (sse * u^0.35) donors by anisotropic RMS radius 0.55 * sqrt(sse / (u * d)) * r * sigma_feat, and read out Empirical-Bayes centroids C_eb (tau=0.20) and local RMS radii ell_k.
Compute prototype-chord Elastic Born-Infeld critic gradient penalty + zero-mean logit gauge and update instance-bound thermal scale s_thermal; step D.

With D fixed, recompute y=G(z) and evaluate SMPFGANLoss: centered adversarial log-odds + thermally coupled debiased physical Born-Infeld s-means prototype Sinkhorn divergence + RMS distortion shell (or affine-detrended whitened IMQ conditional fiber transport on conditioned fibers), plus H_0-connected simplicial chord alignment on zero-sigma ParticlePrior tables and SMPFPriorRegularizer; step G, P and E.

training_details.loss: SMPFGANLoss pairing shift-invariant centered adversarial log-odds with thermally coupled, Kantorovich-Hellinger slack-screened physical Born-Infeld s-means prototype Sinkhorn divergence + Laguerre Monge outlier pull + per-prototype RMS distortion shell on unconditioned continuous/compact-image domains, Nadaraya-Watson detrended coordinate-whitened multi-scale IMQ conditional fiber transport on continuous-conditioned fibers, and standard calibrated GANLoss on discrete simplexes.
training_details.optimizer: Supports DualNorm (selected configuration: zero momentum, smoothing 0.001, per-offset quintic convolution, polar_cpu_v1 dense polar profile, batched SVD backend, BF16 channels-last conv training, direction-blend constraint geometry) as well as native Adam and formulation-owned SMPFCriticAdam without an EMA critic network copy.
training_details.learning_rates: Strictly constant (`lr_floor=1.0`, `network_lr_floor=1.0`): global LR $0.012$, critic multiplier $1.5$ and DualNorm sampled-row prior multiplier $2.5$ (`prior_reg=0.01`).
training_details.gradient_clipping: None. Critic spike guard is disabled; critic and generator transport gradients are bounded smoothly by unit-slope Born-Infeld potentials.
training_details.critic_penalty: s-means EB-prototype-chord Elastic Born-Infeld regularizer evaluated on real endpoints, fake endpoints and mass-weighted prototype Sinkhorn chords ($\kappa=1$, base sharpness $\beta_0=6$ tightening quadratically as transport residual settles, harmonic floor $\lambda_{\mathrm{floor}}=0.01$, chord blend $0.08$) plus a settling zero-mean logit gauge ($\gamma_{\mathrm{gauge}}=0.05$).
training_details.damping_and_guards: Instance-bound shock-filtered transport EMA, state-settling s-means power-cosine prototype turnover, trimmed 1D quantile-$W_2$ floor-subtracted $1/\sqrt{B}$ cooling with 1D DualNorm step-scale damping, prototype-referenced 2D harmonic capture lock, and discrete-simplex post-acquisition Chamfer cooling ($[0.064, 0.084]\to 0.0004$) impedance-matched across critic, generator transport, simplicial chords, and prior regularization.
training_details.noise: No scheduled additive critic-input or generator-output training noise in the selected benchmark configuration ($0.0$). Task-declared MoG intrinsic sigma is preserved.
training_details.averaging: Generator EMA decay=$0$ and serve_average=$0$; all evaluations score live unaveraged weights.

configuration_notes: SMPF translates all four algorithmic pillars of s-means (D^1.5 seeding, tiled L2 assignment, sse_ema x usage^0.35 anisotropic RMS revival across d >= 1, and progressive Empirical-Bayes tau=0.20 shrinkage) into a clock-free, zero-RNG adversarial transport formulation.

All six s-means sufficient-statistics tensors (proto_centroids, proto_usage, proto_sse, feat_scale, fast_sum, fast_count), low-discrepancy phases, and thermal scalars live exclusively on the critic optimizer's instance-bound step record and serialize bit-for-bit through state_dict() and load_state_dict() with strict corruption rejection.

Physical Born-Infeld prototype costs sqrt(ell_k^2 + ||y - C_k^eb||^2) - ell_k match each prototype's quadratic basin curvature to its tracked s-means RMS quantization radius ell_k while bounding long-range sample gradients to unit slope across arbitrary coordinate scales.
One global trainer configuration supplies every displayed result across all tiers and model families without task-specific overrides.

equations.label: Clock-Free Online s-means Distortion-Anisotropic Revival and Empirical-Bayes Centroid Update
equations.explanation: Splits starved prototypes ($u_k<0.10\bar u$) from active donors scored by $\mathrm{sse}_s\cdot u_s^{0.35}$ along online inter-cluster feature spread $\hat{\sigma}_{\mathrm{feat}}$ at exact local RMS distortion scale without arbitrary $\epsilon$, and shrinks rare-mode fast estimates toward smoothed EMA centroids ($\tau_{\mathrm{eb}}=0.20$).

equations.label: Debiased Physical Born-Infeld s-means Prototype Transport and RMS Distortion Shell
equations.explanation: Matches generated samples to Empirical-Bayes prototype masses $w_k$ with prototype-specific Born-Infeld curvature $\ell_k=\sqrt{\mathrm{sse}_k/u_k}$, unit asymptotic gradient slope, entropic self-coupling debiasing, and rare-cluster within-cell dispersion preservation.
